name: Pinboard
description: The Claude pinboard pane for Orca: the focused workspace's latest Claude session as cards (branch, background tasks, intent tree, PRs and links, docs, prompt history) and a memo per workspace.

settings.title: Jira site
settings.description: Your Jira site, e.g. https://your-team.atlassian.net. Issue keys the session mentions link to it. Needs Jira project keys too.

settings.title: Jira project keys
settings.description: Comma-separated project keys to pick up, e.g. WEB,APP. Any other KEY-123 (GPT-4, CVE-2024) is ignored. Needs the Jira site too.
